flows: edit: the field opens holding the line; the new text shows, stays, and survives a reload
swipe: a new reply is the last of its swipes and reads anew; previous shows the reply it replaced; next returns to it

slash palette: offers, in order: /ask Ask | /look Look | /narrate [<what should happen next>] Narrate | /rest Rest | /narrate-character Side character | /advance-time Time passes… | /retry Regenerate | /advance Continue | /pick-speaker Pick who speaks
picker: opens the host's "who speaks next" picker; Escape closes it
message menu: offers Edit, Regenerate, Branch from here, Extend, Swipe, Hide, Select this message for summarization, Change sprite, Inspect run; Escape closes it
branch: opens the branch dialog; Escape closes it
